init.happening: Seed zeros at 0 and ones at infinity.
init.invariant: Only zero cells are known at first.

loop.happening: Sweep a cell in one of the two passes.
loop.why: Each pass relaxes from two directions.
loop.invariant: Every cell is visited once per pass.

check.happening: Test an edge or whether a neighbour is closer.

update.happening: Lower a cell to a closer neighbour's distance + 1.
update.invariant: dist holds the best distance found so far.

return.invariant: Every cell is its true nearest-zero distance.
